tracesTo: SOW: Onboarding, Roles & Access Control - Instant join via invite links
UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment

stories.title: New User Accepts League Invite Link
stories.goal: join a league by clicking an invite link shared by the admin
stories.benefit: I can quickly access the league without complicated signup processes
acceptanceCriteria: User can click invite link from email, message, or social media and be directed to FSHQ invitation page
System validates invite token for authenticity, expiration, and usage limits before proceeding
Invitation page displays league name, description, member count, and inviter details
System shows clear call-to-action button 'Join [League Name]' or 'Accept Invitation'
If user is not authenticated, system prompts to create account or login before accepting invitation
System preserves invite context through authentication flow and auto-accepts after login/registration
System displays clear error messages for invalid, expired, or revoked invite links with guidance

stories.title: System Processes Auto-Approved Invite Acceptance
stories.goal: gain immediate access to league content after accepting an auto-approve invite
stories.benefit: I can start participating in the league immediately without waiting for admin review
acceptanceCriteria: System automatically creates league membership record when user accepts auto-approve invite link
User's role is set according to invite link configuration (manager with team selection or fan)
System redirects user directly to league clubhouse after successful acceptance
User receives welcome notification with league orientation information
System increments invite link usage counter and logs acceptance in invitation analytics
System sends notification to league admin about new member joining via specific invite link
Membership is active immediately with full access to league content and features for assigned role

stories.title: System Processes Manual-Approval Invite Acceptance
stories.goal: submit my request to join a league via invite link that requires admin approval
stories.benefit: I understand my request is being reviewed and can proceed once approved
acceptanceCriteria: System creates pending membership request when user accepts manual-approval invite link
User sees confirmation message: 'Your request to join [League Name] is pending admin approval'
System pre-fills approval queue entry with invite link source and role configuration
User receives email confirmation that their request is pending with estimated review timeframe
System adds user to admin's approval queue with 'Invited via [link ID]' indicator for priority handling
User can view pending status in their account dashboard with option to cancel request
System notifies user via email when admin approves or denies their request

stories.title: Existing User Joins Additional League via Invite
stories.goal: join a new league using an invite link while already having an account
stories.benefit: I can expand my league memberships without creating duplicate accounts
acceptanceCriteria: System recognizes authenticated user clicking invite link and skips account creation step
User sees league preview with 'Join as [username]' button instead of registration form
System adds new league membership to user's existing account without requiring re-authentication
User can immediately switch between leagues using league navigation/switcher after joining
System respects role configuration from invite link when creating membership
If invite link is for manager role, system displays available teams for claiming
System prevents duplicate membership if user is already a member of the target league

stories.title: System Validates Invite Link Constraints
stories.goal: enforce invite link rules and limits during acceptance process
stories.benefit: league access remains controlled according to admin configuration
acceptanceCriteria: System checks invite link expiration timestamp before allowing acceptance
System enforces max usage limit and prevents acceptance if limit is reached
System validates that league membership capacity is not exceeded before creating membership
For manager role invites, system verifies that unclaimed teams are available
System prevents acceptance of revoked invite links with appropriate error message
System enforces rate limiting on invite link access to prevent abuse or scraping
System logs all validation failures in admin audit trail with attempted access details

stories.title: User Selects Team During Manager Invite Acceptance
stories.goal: claim a team while accepting a manager-role invite link
stories.benefit: I can establish my team ownership as part of the invitation flow
acceptanceCriteria: System displays available teams for claiming after user accepts manager invite link
User can browse team list with logos, names, and current availability status
System shows team details (division, conference, recent performance) to aid selection
User must select a team before completing invitation acceptance
System reserves selected team during acceptance process to prevent race conditions
System validates team is still available before finalizing membership
If no teams are available, system provides clear message and option to join as fan instead
